title: 흐름소리 되기: 신라는 왜 [실라]일까요?
objective: Spot ㄴ+ㄹ and ㄹ+ㄴ and read them as [ㄹㄹ], e.g. 신라 [실라], 설날 [설랄].
summary: ㄴ and ㄹ side by side, in either order, both sound like ㄹ: [ㄹㄹ].

task.title: Find and say [ㄹㄹ]
task.line: Look for ㄴ next to ㄹ, then choose, write, or judge the real sound in [ ].

words.exampleMeaning: Gyeongju was the capital of Silla.
I see my family on Lunar New Year's Day.
Please sit next to the heater.
Please take off your shoes indoors.

letters.sound: ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ: 신라 [실라]
ㄴ after ㄹ becomes ㄹ: 설날 [설랄]

exercises: Choose the real sound: ① 한라산 [한나산 / 할라산] ② 칼날 [칸날 / 칼랄] ③ 논리 [놀리 / 논니]
Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 진리 ② 별나라 ③ 전라도
Does the word have a [ㄹㄹ] sound? Write Yes or No: ① 달님 ② 언니 ③ 겨울날
Which pattern is it? Write A (ㄴ+ㄹ) or B (ㄹ+ㄴ): ① 한류 ② 물놀이 ③ 분리
answers: ① Yes [달림] ② No [언니] ③ Yes [겨울랄]
① A [할류] ② B [물로리] ③ A [불리]
